en.topic_title: Tourists chase high-octane thrill in China’s trending biker capital
en.topic_summary:
The roar of engines fills the night air in China’s Chongqing city as tourists awkwardly clamber onto gleaming motorbikes and cling to muscular drivers to star in personalised videos.



This picture taken on July 20, 2026 shows a woman posing for a picture with a motorcycle rider offering photo and video services along a street in Chongqing, southwestern China. Photo: Wang Zhao/AFP.
